Name: Cool Care Heating, Air, Plumbing, and Refrigeration
Reviews:
['Josh and Michael are very professional and assess issues in a timely fashion. They both coordinated with my landlord and were very fast diagnosing the issue and providing him quotes. I felt bad because my landlord kept them on standby and they ended up having to leave to another job because he never responded back to them. Overall I highly recommend Joshua and Michael. Michael came out first diagnosed everything and called Joshua to check it out as well. Very great and timely! Michael was actually early to his appointment!', 'Matt Nelson of Cool Care arrived at my house exactly on time the same day that I called. He identified and corrected the issue with the HVAC very quickly. He was courteous, friendly and very neat. I instantly felt very at ease by his positive attitude and exceptional professionalism. A colleague of his, Kenny ( from a previous home visit ) was also wonderful with the same qualities. When I call cool care they immediately check to see who can come as quickly as possible. I highly recommend them. Amazing customer service! Best experience ever. Thank you Cool Care!', 'We can’t thank Michael enough for his professionalism, expertise and the simple fact he takes pride in his work. He showed up when promised. Is always polite (he’s been our tech before) and seems to enjoy problem solving. He also completed a pretty involved job, in the original time frame. It’s great using  a dependable company like Cool Care!', 'We use Cool Care for our home, rental home, and business. I am always impressed with their communication and professionalism, but their kindness is on another level. Our HVAC went out during a very hot time and we were concerned for the foster animals that we have at home. Cool Care showed up to our home on a Saturday evening to lend us some window units to make it through until we could be scheduled for repair. The kindness and compassion was beyond anything that I expected, we didn’t go one night without our home at least partially cooled and I was so relieved that we were able to keep everyone comfortable.', "Love these people!  Professional,  fast, courteous  and I could go on.   6 months ago We needed a new heat and air unit.  We had several estimates but after meeting the folks at Cool Care we decided to go with them.  They were fast getting our new unit installed and explained everything we needed.  The workmen are great and the people in the office make sure to take care of you.   They answer and/or return phone calls which is a blessing when you need something.   Try them you won't be disappointed.", 'I love the guys at Cool Care, they installed our A/C unit and have been doing our preventative maintenance since… everyone they send out is professional and knowledgeable. The office staff is efficient and effective as well.

Yesterday, Memorial Day, we woke up to a warm house and no A/C, I made a phone call and had someone out the same morning and had us back up and running in no time.

It’s a relief to always know we’ve got our A/C company.', "Highly Recommend Cool Care! Great Service and Pricing!
I have a home that's only 2 years old and the Company that installed my Unit on my New House I contacted for service and they stated they couldn't do servicing because of lack of employees.
So I Contacted Cool Care Heating and Air and they were out the same Day! The Repairman was very open and honest and provided great service!
We also use them at 3 of our Businesses Downtown Columbia and their Services and Pricing even for Businesses Service and Repairs are Wonderful!", 'Brandon called prior to his arrival and was very professional and courteous. He clearly explained the discrepancy with my HVAC and provided the solution and costs upfront. He is very knowledgeable and we are so grateful for him fixing our problem. As a professional handyman myself, I will recommend him and your company to whomever needs your service.', 'Matt was extremely informative and gave the best service.
We look forward to working with your company and so very glad I ran into Kenny at the dumpster that day and he gave me his card as we were in need of service contract for Trane units!
The advertisement on the truck is the best and so glad I saw this that day.
Have a wonderful day and thank you for your help!!!
Lynn Bennett', 'I have been a customer of Cool Care for a few years. They have always provided great service. I’m a disabled widow. My AC went out on the evening of Friday, June 7th. I called them on Sunday as the heat was unbearable. Sarah was so nice. She scheduled Clay for a 1pm appointment. He called me when he was on the way. He walked me through everything. Clay was very thorough. Ants had gotten in the unit and caused a part to short out. The ants were removed, part replaced. He also put in a new air filter and a chemical in the overflow drain so it wouldn’t clog. Additionally, they worked with me on a minor payment issue. They are wonderful! I highly recommend them.', 'Great service from start to finish. Setting the appointment up was easy. The technician Jeff was knowledgeable, kind and took his time to perform our yearly maintenance. We appreciated the follow up call as well.', 'We came home to an air conditioner that was malfunctioning and requested service online.  We expected a service call next week; but to our surprise and relief, we were contacted, and our AC was fixed within 24 hours.  Michael Gillespie came, diagnosed, and clearly explained what was broken with our system and repaired it.  We are very thankful, especially at this time of year, for the attention and quality service we were provided.', "I woke up to a hotbox at 6:30 a.m.  I knew something was wrong with my unit, and immediately began to panic.   I have a house full of folks who HATE being hot, and, we have a baby in the house!   It was already 81° in the house, and outside temps promised 105°.  Not knowing who to call, that would respond quickly,  be professional, honest and affordable,  I put out an APB on our neighborhood Facebook page.  A neighbor referred me to Cool Care.  They had used them recently and were well pleased with service and price.  I called, and spoke to Stacey. She was quick to get all my  info and get someone scheduled as quickly as possible. Technician, Derek, was dispatched to come.  I received a confirmation text that included a picture of Derek,  so I would know who they were sending. That was a plus in my book.  Derek called before he arrived to let me know he would  be here shortly.   He arrived before the time scheduled.   I was so appreciative of that.  Derek was courteous and promptly went to work. He had us up and running in no time flat.  In addition to that, he didn't just repair and leave, he stayed to make sure the unit was cooling properly and tested the air flow and vents to be certain.  I can't say enough good things about Cool Care. They will definitely be my go-to, going forward.

The icing on the cake.......I received a call later in the day from Stacey, just checking in to make sure everything was good.  She also told me if I have ANY issues,  to call them and they'd be back out!  👉 THIS is a company of character!  Not to much of that in the world anymore, is there?", 'Brandon Rehill was exceptional technician he was friendly, kind and professional. I will definitely keep giving my business to Cool Care. I called yesterday and required emergency situation and they were able to take care of me today. I’m a new customer and very satisfied I highly recommend them. Cool Care is cool with me!!!!!!!!', 'Very pleased again! Just a filter cover had fallen down and I needed my gas logs. Pilot light put out. I was notified that the technician was ahead of schedule and could come in before lunch and that freed up my afternoon and I was very appreciative. He fixed everything within five minutes. Thank you.', 'Cool care heating , air , plumbing and refrigeration was Awesome. The Tech Derick that came out represented, patience,  listening and explaining procedure and results. Honored request and actually stuck around to satisfy conscience.  Absolutely professional.', 'I highly recommend Cool Care Heating and Air. We had a new system put in and the guys were wonderful! Very professional and made sure everything was working properly, cleaned up afterwords and so polite and friendly! CJ, Q tip, Keith and I apologize I can’t remember the 4th name but the were spot on getting it installed so quickly bc I it was hot in the attic and they never complained! If you need repairs or a new unit call Cool Care! Thanks again Cool Care!', "Cool Care (CC) communication is top-notch before the appointment. CC rep, Macon, arrived on time, took care of our annual tankless water heater maintenance, measured our water pressure as courtesy to rule out issues with our washer and answered all my plumbing related questions. Very professional and we're very happy with CC's service!
- L Madison", "Ari was great. He's professional and courteous. I highly recommend Cool Care for all your heating and air needs.", 'Customer service is wonderful.  I had Derek E. come out for the 6 month inspection in February and found some needed adjustments to the system that now have it working perfectly again.   The time that Derek took to listen to my concerns, look at the data from my thermostat history, and really dig to figure out the problem was amazing and clearly solved a problem.  Today I noticed something not quite 100% with the stack in the attic and the same day they were able to get Derek back out to address my concerns.  Another quick adjustment because he remembered the work he had done and could troubleshoot easily.', 'Clay does a terrific job. Cool Care always make sure to send a tech that has been to our house before and knows our system. This makes it easier for every problem to be identified and corrected before it gets to be a big problem. We use Cool Care for our plumbing needs now and they do a great job at that too.', 'The technician arrived a little early, which was good. He was very courteous and thorough. He came up with different options after his inspection. He did a great job.', 'Matt and Jose came last minute when I was in need of assistance before going out of town. They were quick, kind and very professional. They were very patient with my questions and even went above and beyond to explain to me the features of the app for the Nest Thermostat they helped install for me after they got it working. Signed up for the maintenance plan with them because of how impressed I was. Thank you Matt and Jose!', 'Matthew is amazing.  Cool Care has continued to make sure we get what we need.   I’ll never use anyone else.', 'Jeff was exceptional all around. He was very informative with everything he did and found along with equally patient with my questions and concerns. He took great care and making sure everything was done at the highest standard. Can’t recommend this company more!', 'Matt was great! He explained my problem, options, and gave me upfront costs!!! I made my choice, the problem was fixed, and he was paid and on his way. ALL in less than 2 hours!! Thanks Cool Care!', 'Cool Care offers excellent service from qualified professionals. Brandon Rehill and Jose Ferreira were thorough and provided detailed feedback. They were both so nice!', 'I want to start my review focusing on the HVAC guys (Matt) who came out to do our spring service. They were extremely thoughtful, kind and patient when explaining issues that they found. They did not make me feel pressured to do anything extra. And while they did recommend a few helpful things they gave me the information so I can research and decide on it the future. Wonderful experience all around.

Secondly, we have had an ongoing issue with a tankless water heater since we bought our home and have had multiple people out to check it and address it and have gotten nowhere.
Enter Derek from Cool Care. He was determined to find our solution and upon discovering what he thought was the problem he laid out all of the possible scenarios to fix it and at no time pressured us to just get a new unit. Like the HVAC individuals, he was patient, kind, and explained things thoroughly. At the end of the day we were able to spend a minimal amount of money and finally solve a 2-year problem. If someone from Cool Care is reading this Derek deserves a raise 😆', 'Matt at Cool Care is a wonderful person who helps me with my HVAC needs and problems. He is quick and kept me informed.  Give the man a raise for his superior service - he deserves it!', 'Travis Myers was at my house today and he provided exceptional service. He was very knowledgeable, informative and courteous. I would highly recommend him', 'We recently installed a REME HALO whole home in-duct air purifier, and immediately noticed the positive effects on our older, moisture prone house. There is a remarkable reduction in dust, a rapid clearing of cooking odors, and a sense of fresh, clean air to our entire house. Our allergy symptoms have also significantly decreased, even during the spring pollen season. We highly recommend installing this unit, and its installation by CoolCare was flawless.', 'I have a maintenence plan with Cool Care. Brandon Rehill is my technician and he always provides excellent service. He is super friendly and explains everything that was found during my service. I really appreciate his customer service!', 'Not happy with service tech quote for air conditioning evaluation.  Gentlemen was polite, however, told me we had big "big problems, showed pictures he took of unit, we could rebuild our 12 year old unit, $4000, replace heating and cooling, 3 ton unit, $10,000, or buy time recharging free-on $880. Pictures showed lots of rust, and bubbles blasting out of unit. (Had inspection 1 year ago with purchase of home)
He had to scroll through his phone to find pictures he JUST TOOK!  Sought 2nd opinion from a friend who uses a different company. Needed a recharge of free-on for a pin hole, no rust...
$248 total, no replacement or rebuild needed.   BEWARE!!!', 'Our compressor broke on a Sunday night. Cool Care sent somebody first thing the next morning. The part was under warranty so unfortunately it had to be ordered from the company. It wasn’t supposed to come in for 5 to 7 business days. Cool Care asked to rush the product because, our young son has asthma and it’s 80° inside the house. Jason is the best tech!!! Can’t say enough good things about this company. They will go above and beyond for their customers . Always answer the phone. Always go the extra mile!! Thank you!!!', 'Brandon was amazing. Communication was top tier from the moment he arrived. He explained all of the potential issues I could run into with my HVAC system as well as all possible solutions that would fit my budget. I will be calling again.', 'Just wanted a preventative maintainance check ran on my 2 exterior units to be ready for summer.  My tech was Jeff Baker and he was absolutely brilliant. Spent about 1.5 hours outside with units. Checked everything and even cleaned units. Had a bad capacitor and he walked me thru process he used to determine issue. Then spent another hour in basement with furnaces checking everything. Extremely professional and I will be a customer for life!', 'Cool Care has been my “go to” HVAC company for over 15 years. They are fabulous. Jeff is my usual tech; he’s the best!', 'Cool Care Heating. Air Plumbing and Refrigeration is awesome. Derek somero the plumber and Matt Nelson HVAC Technician did  an exceptional job. Always ensuring the best results. They were very transparent about everything. I will definitely be encourage others to use this company for HVAC and plumbing. You won’t be disappointed with the service, professionalism, and transparency. Thanks', 'Clay came out and quickly diagnosed the problem. He was friendly, took the time to explain what happened, told me what to watch for in case there were other issues, and was a consummate professional. Couldn’t have been happier.', 'We contacted Cool Care when our gas pack stopped working the first week of January. Mark came out promptly, even though we were not established clients. The heat had come back on shortly before he arrived, but he listened to my explanation of what had been going on and was able to diagnose the problem. He returned the following day to complete some additional work, and was very knowledgeable and professional. Fast forward 2 weeks, and we had a new issue arise, causing us to lose heat on the Friday before a severe cold snap (lows in the teens) was predicted. I called again and Derek was out within a few hours.    He contacted his manager, and together they were able to get us a replacement part on the same day. I have been impressed with all of the staff at Cool Care and they are now our go-to for heating and air.', 'Brandon is a great technician. He took the time to understand what I was wanting done, did a great job explaining issues and making recommendations then completing the maintenance.  I will definitely be requesting him for any HVAC issues in the future.', 'Matt is the best! He quickly diagnosed and fixed the problem. I remembered him from a couple of years back when he came and fixed another issue that a previous technician had missed. Polite and knowledgeable! Next time I call Cool Care I’ll be asking for him.', 'On time? Professional and friendly service! We have used Cool Care for years and they always treat us well. Highly recommend.', 'Excellent service as always. Michael Gillespie was nothing short of a true professional! A great representation of Cool Care!', 'I discovered a leak at 5:30 pm on a Friday night. Thankfully I was able to get service by 7pm. Michael is great. He is knowledgeable, friendly, nice, and explained everything.', 'Was very pleased with the work performed by Brandon  He explained what he was doing and showed pictures of what he did in the attic space . Would definitely recommend Cool Care.', 'Very professional and easy to talk to and got the job done!!! I’m a first time buyer with Cool  Care and I will definitely recommend them!', 'Clay was the best! He explained every step of the service and his thoroughness made me feel assured.', 'Cool Care has been my only HVAC provider for many years and I will keep coming back. Because they have MY back!', 'Derek was very thorough and explained all aspects of the service call and his recommendations so I could make informed decisions about maintaining my unit.', 'Brandon was very nice and explained everything to me where i would understand everything and was very quick called and he was here with in an hour so glad my neighbor recamended me to yall will be using yall from now on and will be telling my friends', "Today 9 months after our re piping reviewed below, our heater stopped working.  I called Cool Care at 7:45 this morning and Stacey set me up for an appointment in the afternoon.  Brandon came, diagnosed the problem and fixed it.  It was all finished by 3:30 and we have heat. Once again Cool Care came through.

Cool Care just finished a major re-piping job at our townhouse in a day and half.  It was a complicated job with 50 year old galvanized  pipes buried under a concrete slab and no one knowing how they ran.  We knew it was a difficult job and were worried about finding someone to do the work.

Rusty came to look at the job and give an estimate.  He was very knowledgeable and reassuring about being able to do the work. He, along with Justin and Seth, arrived on time to start the work and the results were better than I had imagined.  Our water volume, pressure and quality are excellent.  We especially appreciated the clean up!

We're very glad we choose Cool Care to do the work", 'Derek (HVAC) was phenomenal! I highly recommend Cool Care and Derek. My systems are running smoothly. Plus Derek was extremely polite.', 'Arrived on time (a few minutes early), addressed the work to be performed and did a great job. Absolutely recommended!', 'Called Saturday morning and got same day service. Michael showed up exactly when he said he would and had our AC back up in less than an hour. Honestly exceeded my expectations.', 'Our service was great. We have an older system, parts were in short supply but when  came in late Friday afternoon, they installed it same day.', 'Brandon is very knowledgable and confident in his diagnosis and repairs. You always know you will get top notch service from him and the rest of the Cool Care team!', 'Excellent service and wonderful company to work with. Brandon R.  did an excellent job informing us of what was going on with our unit and restoring our service.   Brandon was professional and informative thank you!!!', 'Jeff baker had excellent customer service skills and he’s a great educator on his ability to teach his knowledge on troubleshooting what could be actually wrong with the status of our hvac system. He’s awesome!', 'Clay always does a great and thorough job and makes sure I have no questions. Thanks for the quality work!!', 'After my long term HVAC company retired/sold business, I had several disappointing experiences with trying to find a new company. Cool Care came recommended, and I couldn’t be more pleased! From the initial call to set up seasonal maintenance to the efficient, professional service on my system today - a very good experience. I see now why Cool Care has won “Best of” so many times.', "CAME BACK HOME FROM VACATION ON SAT. JUNE 29 2024, FOUND OUT AC WAS NOT WORKING, IT WAS 105 IN THE HOUSE. CALLED SEVERAL PLACES, NO ONE COULD HELP SINCE ITS SAT. THE LADY WHO ANSWERD THE PHONE FROM COOL CARE WAS SUPER NICE, SHE ACTUALLY UNDERSTOOD WHAT MY SITUATION WAS, AND SOME HOW SHE GOT HER TEC. CAME TO MY HOUSE WITHIN AN HOUR. AND IT WAS 7PM SAT.  IM PRETTY SURE SHE HAD TO TALK TO THE TEC TO STOP BY AFTER HIS LAST JOB ORDER THAT DAY. YOU HAVE NO IDEA HOW MUCH I APPRECIATE IT!! WHAT A SAVE FOR MY LIFE!!! AND MY KIDS SAID YOU GUYS ARE THE BEST AFTER THEY GOT HOME(I SENT WIFE WITH THEM OUT FOR DINNER SO THEY DIDN'T HAVE TO SAY IN 105 DEGREE HOUSE). THE AC WORKS GOOD NOW!! HIGHLY RECOMMANDED!!!!!!", 'Very professional service provided. I work from home and it was as if he wasn’t even in house. To the point with the service provided, explained everything at completion,  all around great service. Tech of choice for future services.', 'In the midst of Reno and ran into snag with plumbing, Derek was   onsight that morning and cured all ills. Cool Care is my go to for all my heating, cooling, and plumbing needs.', 'I had problems getting heat from my gas logs. Charles Young Jr. came and diagnosed the problem and fixed both problems for me.  I am getting a lot more heat and am much more satisfied.  It is great to have someone who knows how the systems work!  Knowledge is power!  Thanks Charles!', 'Mr. Brandon Rehill was on point. Received a courtesy call prior to arrival. Brandon came in and we had great convo through the process. Brandon handed me some great tips until my follow up. Upon completion Brandon was about as thorough as you could ask for. Hopefully Brandon comes back for my next service. Fantastic representation of this company. Thanks Brandon.', 'Cool Care did a great job on the A/C repair! Same day service on a very hot day without the AC!', 'Fantastic service! Super helpful and responsive.

Updating review from 2 years ago - Cool Care technicians - Michael and Matt as well as Dispatcher Sarah were extremely courteous and attentive in performing an emergency repair on our home AC Unit this weekend!', 'Matt represented CoolCare in such a positive way. We needed a thermostat moved and he presented options and explained the work required. I would highly recommend Coolcare. Excellent service', 'Michael G. Did a great job. Very thorough, friendly, and efficient. Highly recommend', 'Excellent service by Brandon. He was on time and corrected my AC issues. He was knowledgable, polite and respectful.', "I've used Cool Care for years and today's service continued to exceed my expectations. Brandon came out to service my HVAC units and did an outstanding job! He was polite upon arrival, respectful of our home, professional in explaining his process, efficient in his use of time, and thorough in his overall servicing of the units. I know I will continue to use Cool Care for all my HVAC needs. They have always been great and Brandon's service today was exceptional!", 'Professional service from Matt, explain to me exactly what the problem was and was able to get my AC working.', 'This is our second great experience with Cool Care. We bought two units from them a couple years back. This time we needed a filter and there was way too much dirt and some freezing . Matt was timely ,friendly and professional. Cool Care is great 👍', "I have already left a 5-star review, but I want to make sure I give a shout-out to Mark, our technician. Mark came back to my 76-yr old disabled mother's house at 9 PM on a Friday night to make sure she didn't have to be in a 90-degree house all night long. Thanks Mark and Cool Care for top-notch service!

I use Cool Care for regular maintenance of my 2 units. They are professional and competent. We also recently had Matthew out to quote us on a new unit. We was professional and provided exceptional customer service. We ended up going with another company for the installation since the price was lower.", 'Brandon was very professional and informative. He kept me informed on all aspects of the different repairs he had to make. I will not only use them with both my condos but I will definitely recommend them to other owners. Cool Care is definitely a 5 star company.', 'Brandon Rehill was my technician today and I cannot say enough positive things about him! He even recommended someone to help me take care of my yard when I mentioned I was having trouble keeping up with it!
His professional qualities, as well, deserve more than 5 stars. He is more than competent. In fact, he is extremely knowledgeable. He took the time to answer all my questions and asked me pointed questions about the heating and cooling to make sure he completely understood my particular usage and situation. He explained how I might save money on power and gas. He really took his time, was very thorough, and gave me more than excellent customer service. I hope he is my regular technician because, not only would I be happy to have him return any time, but I could also trust that I’m receiving top quality service. As I said, I would give more than 5 stars if I could. Cool Care, you are lucky to have technicians like Brandon on your team! (I think you should give him a bonus! 😉). Thank you!!!', 'Michael was great! Very professional. He kept me informed at every stage of the visit.', 'Matt N. has come to our house a few times now for routine care of the HVAC system and has always been on time, quick, honest, and helpful!', 'Called Cool Care for a second opinion concerning a failed compressor, cool care was able to send a technician the next day. I would recommend cool care and our technician Brandon to anyone, great service good people.', 'I call cool care to my building all the time. They usually take care of of my needs in a timely manner. They came out to my house yesterday and this morning I had a new tankless hot water heater! Everyone from Angie and Stacy in the office to the guys who came to service and install are quality people. If you haven't worked with Cool Care, you really should :)", 'Excellent service provided by Brandon Rehill. Thank you Cool Care for having the best technicians!', 'Jason Keech was phenomenal! Very knowledgeable, patient, has exceptional communication skills and is friendly. He explained the entire process of how he found the problem we had (our drainage line was clogged and had backed up into the pan, causing the unit to shut off) and how he was going to fix it and clean it. He educated me on the proper maintenance for the model we have, as well as gave me very insightful information on what to look for in the future for any further problems. Would highly recommend him!', 'This technician was the best.  He explained everything and was very knowledgeable.  Would use him again in a heart beat.', 'I had a great experience with Cool Care! We just moved into our home a few months ago and all of a sudden our AC went out. I knew to call Cool Care as they are prominent in the community and seem to be extremely knowledgable.
